desc:
🌍 **GOD SIMULATION** ⚔️ **AGE OF HEROES UPDATE!**

👑 **BECOME A GOD. CREATE A WORLD. CONTROL ITS DESTINY.**

Create your own living world, build civilizations, watch kingdoms rise and fall, and unleash incredible god powers! Will you protect your people or destroy everything?

⚔️ **NEW! AGE OF HEROES**
- 🛡️ **Human Champion** — Shield Bash, Rally Troops & Divine Strike!
- 🪓 **Orc Warlord** — Ground Slam, Battle Rage & War Cry!
- ⚡ **Elven Stormcaller** — Chain Lightning, Blink & Storm Field!
- 🔨 **Dwarven Juggernaut** — Hammer Quake, Fortify & Iron Guard!
- ⭐ Unique hero appearances, special abilities, powerful combat effects, and hero progression!

🏰 **BUILD YOUR OWN CIVILIZATION**
🌲 Create land, mountains, forests, rivers, and entire worlds!
👥 Spawn Humans, Orcs, Elves, and Dwarves!
👑 Watch villages grow into powerful kingdoms!
⚔️ Start wars, form alliances, and witness massive battles!
🚢 Discover ships, exploration, technology, and evolving civilizations!
